title: Illustration Color
slide_intent: Choose an illustration background deliberately so the subject remains easy to distinguish while retaining a recognizable palette.
strategic_value: Contrasting food-colored tiles can give Burger King varied compositions without changing its illustration assets.
demonstration: A cream instruction column sits beside a tiled field of ingredient and storytelling illustrations on orange, green, red, yellow and brown backgrounds.
practical_value: Select a background from the full brand palette that gives the illustration enough contrast.

content_islands.name: Color guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and background/contrast rules in the left cream column.

content_islands.name: Illustration tiles
content_islands.spec: Fill the remaining area with ingredient, food and character illustrations on contrasting brand-color fields.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy explicitly links background selection to sufficient contrast.
reference_purposes.Expression: The tiled specimens combine food illustrations with saturated brand colors.
reference_purposes.Application: The text directs use of a background from the full palette.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page prohibits amending illustration colors.

ingredient.name: Illustration backgrounds
ingredient.role: Separate the illustrated subject from its field.
ingredient.application: Choose a full-palette background with enough contrast; retain supplied illustration colors.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide; applies to the illustration library, not a numeric contrast standard.
